title: Skill-dispatch benchmark task set (SCAFFOLD — no measurements shipped yet)
description: A replayable task set that proves subprocessing a skill is WORTH IT (Axis 1: token/context savings) AND its results are GOOD (Axis 2: quality >= inline within tolerance). A skill earns `execution: subprocess` only when BOTH axes pass, measured per-skill, never assumed. This schema describes the INPUT (tasks + thresholds); run artifacts/verdicts live under runs/ and results/.

skill.description: The skill under measurement, e.g. 'scan:full' or 'research:deep'. Must already be subprocess_verified (a ping smoke proved it RUNS headless) before measurement is meaningful.

subprocess_verified_prereq.description: Asserts a ping smoke test proved the skill runs headless before this task set was authored.

thresholds.description: The fail-closed bars BOTH axes must clear. A skill qualifies for subprocess ONLY when all are met across the task set.

min_tokens_saved.description: Axis 1: minimum net orchestrator tokens saved (inline_orchestrator_tokens - (envelope_tokens + dispatch_overhead)). Light skills whose output is already small fall below this and STAY INLINE.

min_pct_saved.description: Axis 1: minimum fraction of inline orchestrator cost saved (e.g. 0.6 = the envelope must cost <=40% of inline).

quality_tolerance.description: Axis 2: how far BELOW inline quality the subprocess result may fall and still pass (e.g. 0.05 = within 5%). 0 = subprocess must be >= inline.

judge.description: Axis 2 quality grader. Independent + cross-provider (no self-grading — diff-model-review). Used for the SUBJECTIVE delta and high-risk routing/calibration; where a gold expectation exists, grade against it FIRST (the judge is not the sole oracle).

provider.description: A provider DIFFERENT from the skill's executor (cross-provider).

anonymized.description: Arms presented to the judge WITHOUT inline/subprocess labels (blind A/B).

rubric.description: What 'good' means for this skill's output.

tasks.description: Representative inputs replayed under BOTH arms (inline + subprocess). A single run is insufficient — several tasks average out retries/summarization/review churn.

input.description: The exact skill input/args for this task.

gold.description: Gold/human expectation, when one exists — graded FIRST. Optional; some skills only have a rubric.
